brief.aim: The table was evidently assembled to model hourly rental demand: cnt is the total rented bikes and the remaining columns are calendar, weather and comfort covariates. cnt is a single numeric count, so regression on cnt is the defensible default. instant is a pure row index and must not be a feature; casual and registered are the component counts that sum to cnt, so they are leakage and must be excluded. Rows are consecutive hourly periods of one series (dteday plus hr give chronological order), so temporal splitting is required.
brief.repeated_subjects: None; rows form one continuous hourly series of the same system, so chronological splitting is the relevant constraint.
brief.unit: One hourly bike-rental record (a single hour of the shared-bike system's operation)
